_comment: Prompt-regression fixture from the 2026-08-04 audit (docs/PROMPTS.md). PER-TIER ground truth: the tiers are asymmetric by design — 'advance on no information' is correct for a $0.0002 prescreen (gt_t1) and wrong for the authoritative scorer that decides a paying user's board (gt_t2): Tier-2 scoring an empty or benefits-only JD low is right (don't board what you can't evidence). Bands: B=blocker, M=middle/adjacent, H=genuine. Tier-1 bands: B<=30, M 31-59, H>=60. Tier-2: B<=39, M 40-59, H>=60. Used by scripts/eval_scorers.py --mode regress.
